text_block_list.text: One day during lunch break...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Would it be alright if I changed the 
route I run on the perimeter for a 
while...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I've also prepared an alternative course 
just in case. I don't believe there should 
be any difference in distance or load, 
but...

She handed me a tablet, so I checked the 
screen... and tilted my head. Huh?
choice_data_list:
Are you sure this is okay? It doesn't pass 
through the used bookstore district.

text_block_list.text:
Normally, sometimes while taking a break 
from running—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! That secondhand bookstore has a bargain 
cart out today...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Trainer! Could you... j-just give me 
10 minutes—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually... I'm currently saving up to 
buy a new camera lens...

I see. Indeed, if that's the reason, you'd 
certainly want to avoid the tempting 
secondhand bookstore district.
choice_data_list: Got it. Good luck saving up!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! Yes! I'm so close to achieving it... 
I'll do my best!

“—A few days later, as I was walking down 
the hallway...”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ugh... gotta hold it in, hold it in...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... "Hoofprints of the Final Run 
II"... It should be in bookstores right 
now... If I could just go take a look...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...N-No way, no no! Trainer is helping me 
out, so I can't give up...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
P-Patience, patience! Endure it, endure 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's it, hang in there, hang in there! 
Just a little longer, Chrono-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's go for a run to clear our 
heads! Carving our hoofprints into the 
mile will definitely cheer us up!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Please allow me to join you as well. —And 
later, allow me to send you some 
congratulatory flowers, too.
—A few days later.
choice_data_list: Alright, that's it for today's training...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Thank you for your hard work...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, there's a flash sale on daily 
necessities today! I-I'm heading out...!
choice_data_list:
...You're really working hard on saving up 
for that camera.

text_block_list.text: —And so, during lunch break one day.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer! Thank you so much for your help 
with this...!"
choice_data_list:
Ah! Did you reach your savings goal, by 
any chance?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! This is all thanks to your help, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list:

already?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No. Um... we have a quiz this week. I 
thought if I bought it, I wouldn't be able 
to study at all...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! Everything's finished for 
today! I'm going to go buy it tomorrow on 
my day off...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
So, I'll do a test shoot for a day... and 
hopefully take it with me to the next 
race.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
This lens is exceptionally good at panning 
shots, so I should be able to capture even 
more dynamic photos than before...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Fufu...♪

And if I stop by and buy it on the way 
back, I should be able to spend the whole 
day tomorrow test-shooting.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san...
choice_data_list:
A reward for working so hard saving up for 
that camera.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Very much so...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since the day I made up my mind, 
I've dreamed of taking photos with this 
lens."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking... how nice it would be if 
I could take photos where you can feel the 
history just by looking at them.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The more I held back, the bigger the 
excitement grew...
choice_data_list:
Will you show me if you get any good 
photos?

If you get any good photos, will you show

text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Of course...!
